Ui.Script:
local mobile = GetCVar("mobileInterface") == "1" local zh = GetLocale() == "zhCN" or GetLocale() == "zhTW"
-- ══ The switch, in both layouts ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ local Toggle = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaMobileToggle", UIParent, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") Toggle:SetFrameStrata("HIGH") Toggle:SetWidth(mobile and 120 or 72) Toggle:SetHeight(mobile and 44 or 22) if mobile then Toggle:SetText(zh and "电脑界面" or "PC UI") else Toggle:SetText(zh and "手机" or "Mobile") end Toggle:SetScript("OnClick", function() SetCVar("mobileInterface", mobile and "0" or "1") ReloadUI() end) if not mobile then Toggle:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", UIParent, "TOPRIGHT", -196, -6) return end
-- ══ Pieces ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ local function Texture(parent, file, layer, width, height) local texture = parent:CreateTexture(nil, layer or "BACKGROUND") texture:SetTexture(file) if width then texture:SetWidth(width) texture:SetHeight(height) end return texture end
local function Resize(text, size) local file, _, flags = text:GetFont() text:SetFont(file, size, flags) end
-- Moves a frame to an anchor, scaled, keeping the offsets in unscaled units. local function Place(frame, point, relative, relativePoint, x, y, scale) if not frame then return end scale = scale or frame:GetScale() frame:SetScale(scale) frame:ClearAllPoints() frame:SetPoint(point, relative, relativePoint, (x or 0) / scale, (y or 0) / scale) end
-- A bar: its fill cut to the fraction, from a status bar texture. local function Bar(parent, width, height, r, g, b) local bar = CreateFrame("Frame", nil, parent) bar:SetWidth(width) bar:SetHeight(height) local track = Texture(bar, "Interface\\Tooltips\\UI-Tooltip-Background", "BACKGROUND") track:SetVertexColor(0, 0, 0, 0.7) track:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", bar, "TOPLEFT", -2, 2) track:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", bar, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 2, -2) local fill = Texture(bar, "Interface\\TargetingFrame\\UI-StatusBar", "ARTWORK") fill:SetVertexColor(r, g, b) fill:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", bar, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) fill:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", bar, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0) local text = bar:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "TextStatusBarText") text:SetPoint("CENTER", bar, "CENTER", 0, 0) bar.fill, bar.text = fill, text function bar:SetColor(r, g, b) self.fill:SetVertexColor(r, g, b) end function bar:Set(value, max) local fraction = max and max > 0 and math.min(math.max(value / max, 0), 1) or 0 if fraction == self.fraction then return end self.fraction = fraction self.fill:SetTexCoord(0, fraction, 0, 1) self.fill:SetWidth(math.max(self:GetWidth() * fraction, 0.01)) if fraction <= 0 then self.fill:Hide() else self.fill:Show() end end bar:Set(0, 1) return bar end
-- A round icon button. local function IconButton(parent, name, file, size, onClick, label) local button = CreateFrame("Button", name, parent) button:SetWidth(size) button:SetHeight(size) local icon = Texture(button, file, "ARTWORK") icon:SetAllPoints(button) button.icon = icon -- Round and at 1:1; the tracking border below stood at 1.7x and showed its sawtooth. local rim = Texture(button, "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8", "OVERLAY") SetPortraitToTexture(rim, "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8") rim:SetWidth(size * 1.14) rim:SetHeight(size * 1.14) rim:SetPoint("CENTER", button, "CENTER", 0, 0) rim:SetVertexColor(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.8) button:SetHighlightTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square") button:GetHighlightTexture():SetBlendMode("ADD") button:SetScript("OnMouseDown", function() this.icon:SetVertexColor(0.7, 0.7, 0.7) end) button:SetScript("OnMouseUp", function() this.icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) end) if onClick then button:SetScript("OnClick", onClick) end if label then local text = button:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalLarge") text:SetPoint("TOP", button, "BOTTOM", 0, -2) text:SetText(label) button.label = text end return button end
local Hud = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaMobileHud", UIParent) Hud:SetAllPoints(UIParent) Hud:SetFrameStrata("LOW")
local Hidden = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaMobileHiddenParent", UIParent) Hidden:Hide()
local function Hide(frame) if frame then frame:SetParent(Hidden) end end -- ══ Portrait rings ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ local RING = 150 local POWER_COLORS = { [0] = { 0.1, 0.45, 1 }, [1] = { 0.95, 0.1, 0.1 }, [2] = { 1, 0.6, 0.1 }, [3] = { 1, 0.9, 0.1 }, }
local function UnitRing(unit, name, x) local ring = CreateFrame("Button", name, Hud) ring:SetWidth(RING + 280) ring:SetHeight(RING) ring:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", Hud, "TOPLEFT", x, -4) ring:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") ring.unit = unit -- The portrait is engine-masked to its inscribed circle (`SetPortraitToTexture`'s -- `circular` flag), so it is the one round thing here that has no edge to clean up. local portrait = ring:CreateTexture(name .. "Portrait", "BACKGROUND") portrait:SetWidth(RING * 0.96) portrait:SetHeight(RING * 0.96) portrait:SetPoint("CENTER", ring, "LEFT", RING / 2, 0) ring.portrait = portrait -- The frame around it: two flat textures, both round and both at 1:1, so their edges -- are the rasteriser's. `Interface\Minimap\MiniMap-TrackingBorder` used to sit here -- at 2.4x (RING * 1.62 over a 128px art), which magnified its hand-drawn rim into the -- hard sawtooth the mobile HUD showed. local rim = ring:CreateTexture(name .. "Rim", "BACKGROUND") SetPortraitToTexture(name .. "Rim", "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8") rim:SetWidth(RING * 1.12) rim:SetHeight(RING * 1.12) rim:SetPoint("CENTER", portrait, "CENTER", 0, 0) rim:SetVertexColor(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.85) portrait:SetDrawLayer("BORDER") ring.level = ring:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalLarge") ring.level:SetPoint("BOTTOM", portrait, "BOTTOM", 0, -6) Resize(ring.level, 20) ring.name = ring:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalLarge") Resize(ring.name, 22) ring.name:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", ring, "TOPLEFT", RING + 6, -18) ring.name:SetJustifyH("LEFT") ring.health = Bar(ring, 260, 22, 0.1, 0.9, 0.1) ring.health:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", ring.name, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) ring.power = Bar(ring, 260, 22, 0.1, 0.45, 1) ring.power:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", ring.health, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -10) Resize(ring.health.text, 16) Resize(ring.power.text, 16) return ring end
local function UpdateRing(ring) local unit = ring.unit if not UnitExists(unit) then return end local level = UnitLevel(unit) ring.level:SetText(level and level > 0 and level or "??") ring.name:SetText(UnitName(unit)) if unit == "target" then local reaction = UnitReaction(unit, "player") or 4 local color = UnitReactionColor and UnitReactionColor[reaction] if color then ring.name:SetTextColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end end local health, healthMax = UnitHealth(unit), UnitHealthMax(unit) ring.health:Set(health, healthMax) ring.health.text:SetText(health .. " / " .. healthMax) local powerType = UnitPowerType(unit) or 0 if powerType ~= ring.powerType then ring.powerType = powerType local c = POWER_COLORS[powerType] or POWER_COLORS[0] ring.power:SetColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) end local mana, manaMax = UnitMana(unit), UnitManaMax(unit) ring.power:Set(mana, manaMax) ring.power.text:SetText(manaMax > 0 and (mana .. " / " .. manaMax) or "") if manaMax > 0 then ring.power:Show() else ring.power:Hide() end end
local Player = UnitRing("player", "BenillaMobilePlayerRing", 8) Player:SetScript("OnClick", function() if arg1 == "RightButton" then ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, PlayerFrameDropDown, "BenillaMobilePlayerRing", 120, 20) else TargetUnit("player") end end)
local Target = UnitRing("target", "BenillaMobileTargetRing", 460) Target:Hide() -- A tap opens the stock unit menu: whisper, invite, trade, follow, duel, inspect. Target:SetScript("OnClick", function() ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, TargetFrameDropDown, "BenillaMobileTargetRing", 120, 20) end)
-- ══ Stick ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -- Drawn here, driven by the engine: `touch_mouse` holds the finger that lands on it and -- moves the knob through BenillaMobileStick_SetKnob. local Stick = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaMobileStick", Hud) Stick:SetWidth(260) Stick:SetHeight(260) Stick:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", Hud, "BOTTOMLEFT", 40, 30) -- Mouse-enabled so a press on it is the UI's and never also the world's. Stick:EnableMouse(true) -- Round fills: a flat texture cut to the portrait circle. local stickBase = Stick:CreateTexture("BenillaMobileStickBase", "BACKGROUND") SetPortraitToTexture("BenillaMobileStickBase", "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8") stickBase:SetAllPoints(Stick) stickBase:SetVertexColor(0, 0, 0, 0.35) -- Native scale, round, one flat texture: no magnified hand-drawn rim. local stickRing = Stick:CreateTexture("BenillaMobileStickRing", "BORDER") SetPortraitToTexture("BenillaMobileStickRing", "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8") stickRing:SetWidth(250) stickRing:SetHeight(250) stickRing:SetPoint("CENTER", Stick, "CENTER", 0, 0) stickRing:SetVertexColor(1, 0.82, 0.3, 0.35) local knob = Stick:CreateTexture("BenillaMobileStickKnob", "ARTWORK") SetPortraitToTexture("BenillaMobileStickKnob", "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8") knob:SetWidth(110) knob:SetHeight(110) knob:SetVertexColor(1, 0.82, 0.3, 0.8) knob:SetPoint("CENTER", Stick, "CENTER", 0, 0)
function BenillaMobileStick_SetKnob(dx, dy) knob:SetPoint("CENTER", Stick, "CENTER", dx, dy) end -- ══ Action wheel ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -- Six action slots on two arcs around the jump button, pages 1-6 and 7-12. local Wheel = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaMobileWheel", Hud) Wheel:SetWidth(1) Wheel:SetHeight(1) Wheel:SetPoint("CENTER", Hud, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -110, 110) Wheel.offset = 0
local SLOT = 96 local slots = { { 165, 180 }, { 165, 135 }, { 165, 90 }, { 290, 172 }, { 290, 132 }, { 290, 92 } } local actionButtons = {}
local function WheelUpdate(button) local old = this this = button ActionButton_Update() this = old button:Show() local hotkey = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "HotKey") if hotkey then hotkey:SetText("") end end
local function WheelRefresh() local bonus = GetBonusBarOffset() > 0 for i, button in ipairs(actionButtons) do button.isBonus = bonus button:SetID(i + Wheel.offset) WheelUpdate(button) end end
for i, place in ipairs(slots) do local x, y = place[1] * cos(place[2]), place[1] * sin(place[2]) local button = CreateFrame("CheckButton", "BenillaMobileActionButton" .. i, Wheel, "ActionBarButtonTemplate") button:SetID(i) Place(button, "CENTER", Wheel, "CENTER", x, y, SLOT / 36) button.showgrid = 1 actionButtons[i] = button end
local wheelEvents = CreateFrame("Frame", nil, Wheel) for _, e in ipairs({ "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD", "UPDATE_BONUS_ACTIONBAR", "ACTIONBAR_PAGE_CHANGED", "ACTIONBAR_SLOT_CHANGED" }) do wheelEvents:RegisterEvent(e) end wheelEvents:SetScript("OnEvent", WheelRefresh)
-- Jump and autorun are the engine's to fire (`touch_mouse`): mouse-off frames it hits. local function EngineButton(name, file, size) local frame = CreateFrame("Frame", name, Hud) frame:SetWidth(size) frame:SetHeight(size) frame:EnableMouse(true) local icon = Texture(frame, file, "ARTWORK") icon:SetAllPoints(frame) local rim = Texture(frame, "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8", "OVERLAY", size * 1.14, size * 1.14) SetPortraitToTexture(rim, "Interface\\Buttons\\WHITE8X8") rim:SetPoint("CENTER", frame, "CENTER", 0, 0) rim:SetVertexColor(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.8) return frame end local JumpButton = EngineButton("BenillaMobileJump", "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Rogue_Sprint", 116) JumpButton:SetPoint("CENTER", Wheel, "CENTER", 0, 0)
local Switch = IconButton(Hud, "BenillaMobileWheelSwitch", "Interface\\Buttons\\UI-EmptySlot-Disabled", 72, function() Wheel.offset = Wheel.offset == 0 and 6 or 0 this.page:SetText(Wheel.offset == 0 and "1" or "2") WheelRefresh() end) Switch:SetPoint("CENTER", Wheel, "CENTER", 0, 400) Switch.page = Switch:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalHuge") Switch.page:SetPoint("CENTER", Switch, "CENTER", 0, 0) Switch.page:SetText("1")
local NextTarget = IconButton(Hud, "BenillaMobileTargetNearest", "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Hunter_SniperShot", 84, function() TargetNearestEnemy() end) NextTarget:SetPoint("CENTER", Wheel, "CENTER", -200, 330) -- ══ Menu, camera, chat ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ local Menu = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaMobileMenu", UIParent) Menu:SetFrameStrata("DIALOG") Menu:SetWidth(780) Menu:SetHeight(400) Menu:SetPoint("CENTER", UIParent, "CENTER", 0, 40) Menu:EnableMouse(true) Menu:SetBackdrop({ bgFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Background", edgeFile = "Interface\\DialogFrame\\UI-DialogBox-Border", tile = true, tileSize = 32, edgeSize = 32, insets = { left = 11, right = 12, top = 12, bottom = 11 }, }) Menu:Hide() do local items = { { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Helmet_03", CHARACTER_BUTTON, function() ToggleCharacter("PaperDollFrame") end }, { "Interface\\Buttons\\Button-Backpack-Up", zh and "背包" or "Bags", function() OpenAllBags() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Book_09", SPELLBOOK_ABILITIES_BUTTON, function() ToggleSpellBook(BOOKTYPE_SPELL) end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Marksmanship", TALENTS_BUTTON, function() ToggleTalentFrame() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Note_01", QUESTLOG_BUTTON, function() ToggleQuestLog() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Map_01", WORLDMAP_BUTTON, function() ToggleWorldMap() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Note_02", SOCIAL_BUTTON, function() ToggleFriendsFrame() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\Spell_Holy_PrayerOfSpirit", zh and "坐下/站立" or "Sit", function() SitOrStand() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_QuestionMark", HELP_BUTTON, function() ToggleHelpFrame() end }, { "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Gear_01", MAINMENU_BUTTON, function() ToggleGameMenu(1) end }, } for i, item in ipairs(items) do local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 5) local column = i - 1 - row * 5 local run = item[3] local button = IconButton(Menu, "BenillaMobileMenu" .. i, item[1], 96, function() Menu:Hide() run() end, item[2]) button:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", Menu, "TOPLEFT", 58 + column * 140, -44 - row * 180) end local close = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaMobileMenuClose", Menu, "UIPanelCloseButton") close:SetWidth(64) close:SetHeight(64) close:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", Menu, "TOPRIGHT", 4, 4) end
local MenuButton = IconButton(Hud, "BenillaMobileMenuButton", "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Gear_01", 80, function() if Menu:IsShown() then Menu:Hide() else Menu:Show() end end) MenuButton:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", Hud, "TOPRIGHT", -300, -70) local ZoomIn = IconButton(Hud, "BenillaMobileZoomIn", "Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up", 64, function() CameraZoomIn(3) end) ZoomIn:SetPoint("TOP", MenuButton, "BOTTOM", 0, -22) local ZoomOut = IconButton(Hud, "BenillaMobileZoomOut", "Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up", 64, function() CameraZoomOut(3) end) ZoomOut:SetPoint("TOP", ZoomIn, "BOTTOM", 0, -22)
local Chat = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaMobileChatButton", Hud, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") Chat:SetWidth(220) Chat:SetHeight(64) Chat:SetPoint("BOTTOM", Hud, "BOTTOM", -20, 6) Chat:SetText(CHAT or (zh and "聊天" or "Chat")) Chat:SetScript("OnClick", function() ChatFrame_OpenChat("") end) local AutoRun = EngineButton("BenillaMobileAutoRun", "Interface\\Icons\\Ability_Tracking", 80) AutoRun:SetPoint("RIGHT", Chat, "LEFT", -30, 0)
local Xp = Bar(Hud, 600, 10, 0.58, 0, 0.55) Xp:SetPoint("BOTTOM", Hud, "BOTTOM", -20, 80) -- ══ The stock frames ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -- Windows, menus and tooltips a size up, so their buttons take a finger. local Bigger = { "CharacterFrame", "SpellBookFrame", "QuestLogFrame", "FriendsFrame", "GameMenuFrame", "BenillaOptionsFrame", "MerchantFrame", "GossipFrame", "QuestFrame", "LootFrame", "TaxiFrame", "TradeFrame", "BankFrame", "MailFrame", "OpenMailFrame", "HelpFrame", "PetStableFrame", "TabardFrame", "GuildRegistrarFrame", "PetitionFrame", "ItemTextFrame", "DressUpFrame", "GroupLootFrame1", "StaticPopup1", "StaticPopup2", "StaticPopup3", "StaticPopup4", "GameTooltip", "ItemRefTooltip", "ContainerFrame1", "ContainerFrame2", "ContainerFrame3", "ContainerFrame4", "ContainerFrame5", "ClassTrainerFrame", "TalentFrame", "WorldMapFrame", }
local function Arrange() Hide(PlayerFrame) Hide(TargetFrame) Hide(MainMenuBar) Hide(MultiBarBottomLeft) Hide(MultiBarBottomRight) Hide(MultiBarLeft) Hide(MultiBarRight) if ShapeshiftBarFrame then ShapeshiftBarFrame:SetParent(Hud) Place(ShapeshiftBarFrame, "BOTTOMRIGHT", Hud, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -460, 20, 1.5) end if PetActionBarFrame then PetActionBarFrame:SetParent(Hud) Place(PetActionBarFrame, "BOTTOMRIGHT", Hud, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -480, 110, 1.3) end if MinimapCluster then Place(MinimapCluster, "TOPRIGHT", UIParent, "TOPRIGHT", 0, -40, 1.3) end if TemporaryEnchantFrame then Place(TemporaryEnchantFrame, "TOPRIGHT", UIParent, "TOPLEFT", 460, -160, 1.2) end if PartyMemberFrame1 then Place(PartyMemberFrame1, "TOPLEFT", UIParent, "TOPLEFT", 10, -200, 1.2) end if CastingBarFrame then Place(CastingBarFrame, "BOTTOM", UIParent, "BOTTOM", 0, 330, 1.3) end if ChatFrame1 then ChatFrame1:ClearAllPoints() ChatFrame1:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", UIParent, "BOTTOMLEFT", 340, 100) ChatFrame1:SetWidth(520) ChatFrame1:SetHeight(150) if FCF_SetChatWindowFontSize then FCF_SetChatWindowFontSize(ChatFrame1, 16) end end for _, name in ipairs(Bigger) do local frame = getglobal(name) if frame then frame:SetScale(1.3) end end for i = 1, 3 do local list = getglobal("DropDownList" .. i) if list then list:SetScale(1.5) end end end
-- Tooltips without an owner's anchor go left of the minimap, clear of the wheel. function GameTooltip_SetDefaultAnchor(tooltip, parent) tooltip:SetOwner(parent, "ANCHOR_NONE") tooltip:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", UIParent, "TOPRIGHT", -400 / tooltip:GetScale(), -280 / tooltip:GetScale()) end
Toggle:SetParent(Hud) Toggle:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", Hud, "TOPRIGHT", -260, -8)
-- ══ Updates ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ local function UpdatePortraits() SetPortraitTexture(Player.portrait, "player") if UnitExists("target") then SetPortraitTexture(Target.portrait, "target") end end
Hud:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD") Hud:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED") Hud:RegisterEvent("UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE") Hud:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if event == "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD" then Arrange() elseif event == "PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED" then if UnitExists("target") then Target:Show() UpdateRing(Target) else Target:Hide() end end UpdatePortraits() end)
local elapsed = 0 Hud:SetScript("OnUpdate", function() elapsed = elapsed + arg1 if elapsed < 0.1 then return end elapsed = 0 UpdateRing(Player) if Target:IsShown() then UpdateRing(Target) end Xp:Set(UnitXP("player"), UnitXPMax("player")) end)
Arrange() WheelRefresh()
